high_level_description: The image depicts the aftermath of a tragic accident involving a school van that was struck by a train at a railway crossing in Tamil Nadu, India. The text at the top of the image reads: "Two students killed after train hits school van at railway crossing in Tamil Nadu" by Pramod Madhav, posted 8 hours ago. The setting appears to be an outdoor area near a railway track, with greenery and some structures visible in the background. The railway crossing gate is not clearly visible but can be inferred from the context of the accident.
